values: Simple current-state view based on v1.9 and runtime/BAPI evidence through 25 Aug 2026
BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE is the standard BAPI equivalent. The selected implementation remains API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV; its internal call path has not been traced.

Runtime-certified in QS4/700 on 25 Aug 2026. Standard OData created material document 5007138616/2026 with PO 5600084238/00010 and delivery 9004953150/000010. OData readback, MSEG and predecessor consumption confirmed the posting. Batch-split receipts remain untested.

Use the standard service. Require GoodsMovementRefDocType B and send both PO/item and delivery/item. Read the live delivery structure before posting batch-managed materials. Add duplicate handling and reversal after the remaining tests.
GM code 01; RefDocType B; movement 101; material 17035056; 1022/FKGU; 4 EA; PO 5600084238/00010; delivery 9004953150/000010
Certified — non-batch STO receipt proven; batch split open

BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_STO is called internally for the STO path. Proven on 25 Aug 2026 by an external breakpoint during the standard OData POST. BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_SLS remains the expected sales-order path and is not yet traced.

Proven end to end in QS4: OData created delivery 9004953174 and LIKP/LIPS confirmed persistence. A separate debugger run proved that the standard service calls BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_STO for STO creation. Trade and Non-trade remain untraced.

Reuse the proven standard deep insert; no custom delivery-creation wrapper is required. Test Trade and Non-trade sales-order predecessors, then add only CPI/T2 replay, error mapping and response shaping.
Complete — STO OData and internal BAPI path proven
No equivalent BAPI selected. BAPI_MATERIAL_AVAILABILITY is ATP and answers a different question.
Metadata and empty reads are proven. DS4 has no book-stock rows, so populated quantities have not yet been reconciled.
Use filtered reads by plant, storage location, material, batch and stock type. Reconcile against MMBE/MB52. Keep descriptions and stock ageing in T2/Datasphere.
Delivery-v2 picking actions plus existing SAP LE-TRA freight functions
BAPI_SHIPMENT_CREATE; SD_SCDS_CREATE; SD_SCD_ITEM_CALCULATE; SD_SCD_ITEM_ACCT_ASSIGNMENT; SD_SCDS_RELEASE; SD_SCDS_SAVE
Shipment creation persisted when explicitly committed. Cost creation is callable and release runs headless, but a real freight document has not been settled end to end.
Build ZCNF_PREPGI_SRV as a controlled wrapper/orchestrator. Reuse SAP freight logic; add commit boundaries, stage state, locking, partial-failure recovery and one real settlement test.
No BAPI selected. Existing client code also uses WS_DELIVERY_UPDATE, but the standard OData action is preferred.
Function signatures and metadata are confirmed; PostGoodsIssue itself has not yet been executed in the current test pack.
Execute PGI and reversal against a controlled delivery, read back the material document/document flow, and confirm movement behaviour for Trade, Non-trade and STO.
API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV for read/PDF only; it cannot create billing documents
BAPI_BILLINGDOC_CREATEMULTIPLE + BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT; SD_CUSTOMER_INVOICES_CREATE remains an internal alternative
The released billing OData create route does not exist. The BAPI is used by the client's ZMM_STO_AUTO_POSTING report but has not been executed in the current API test pack.
Build ZCNF_BILLING_SRV around the BAPI, own commit and persistence checks, then read back through the standard billing API and hand off to the existing statutory process.
API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV can read POs but its create operation does not support the required STO shape
BAPI_PO_CREATE1 + BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT; ZMM_STO_AUTO_POSTING is the client reference implementation

OData create was executed and structurally rejected ZP06/PSTYP 7. BAPI testing passed STO document-type validation with UB, and client code supplies the exact ZP06 payload. A real ZP06 create is still pending.

Build ZCNF_STO_SRV using the client's actual payload: supplying plant in VENDOR, purchasing group 119, storage location, BANFN and BEDNR mappings, X structures, commit, replay protection and readback.
Existing SAP eDocument + DigiGST/EY provider route; no standard SEGW service
No BAPI identified. BADI_EDOCUMENT_IN_EWB is an enhancement point, not the callable API.
The installed framework, DigiGST tables and EY destinations are confirmed. The callable class/FM and a real extension request have not been traced.
Trace the supported add-on call and provider response first. Expose only a narrow CNF command if no approved callable boundary already exists; never update statutory tables directly.
Existing SAP eDocument + DigiGST/EY correction/cancel/regenerate route
No justified BAPI for the required transport-detail correction
Historical correction cycles exist, but the supported callable implementation and separate e-Invoice/E-Way Bill outcomes are not yet proven.
Trace the existing add-on action, confirm cancel/regenerate behaviour, then expose a narrow command only if required. Do not directly update billing or DigiGST tables.
Bottom line: no complete custom business-process rebuild is currently proven necessary. Custom SAP work is mainly controlled exposure/orchestration around standard or existing logic.
This matrix contains the nine real implementation services. The non-existent 'Show Inward MRNs' placeholder is intentionally excluded.
